theater: 多瑙河下游、埃迪爾內與卡爾斯

battle.name: 第八次俄土戰爭
battle.theater: 多瑙河下游、埃迪爾內與卡爾斯
battle.brief: 一八二八年六月，迪比奇率俄軍渡過普魯特河，圍困西利斯特拉並攻入布加勒斯特；高加索方面，帕斯克維奇取下阿哈爾察利與卡爾斯，迫使埃里溫歸入俄羅斯。翌年六月俄軍在埃迪爾內擊潰鄂圖曼主力，卡爾斯要塞在圍城一年後投降，蘇丹求和。長槍在這個時代只存在於哥薩克長矛與鄂圖曼長矛的序列之中。

kit.name: 長槍
kit.history: 方陣的長矛讓火槍隊站在後面。密西西比之後，長矛和火槍一起站住了。

countries: 一八二八至一八二九年的第八次俄土戰爭，交戰方是俄羅斯帝國與鄂圖曼帝國，但真正的局面由三個附加角色決定：亞美尼亞與格魯吉亞的諸侯、正在爭取獨立的希臘，以及英法兩國的干預。俄羅斯是進攻方。沙皇尼古拉一世自一八二五年即位後把對外重心放在三件事上：把黑海變成俄羅斯的內湖，奪取鄂圖曼在高加索的門戶，並解決俄羅斯商人被拒於博斯普魯斯海峽之外的通商問題。一八二七年俄羅斯與伊朗的戰爭以土庫曼恰伊條約收場，亞美尼亞與埃里溫落入俄羅斯之手，鄂圖曼在東翼的處境因此惡化。一八二八年春，迪比奇元帥率主力渡過普魯特河向多瑙河下游推進，高加索方向則由維特根斯坦與帕斯克維奇指揮，兩路同時壓上。鄂圖曼方面由蘇丹馬哈茂德二世主持國政，他自一八二六年清除禁衛軍之後正著手重整軍隊，紅軍與新式常備軍尚在組建之中，線狀步兵的裝備雜亂而訓練不均，軍官多出自舊體系。外交上，英國與法國擔心俄羅斯獨佔黑海，傾向阻止聖彼得堡進一步逼近君士坦丁堡，但實際行動只限於外交施壓與海上監視，並未出兵。希臘問題則像一根引線：俄羅斯以支持希臘起義為名介入，鄂圖曼則把對希臘的讓步視為屈辱，使這場衝突無法在不傷體面的情況下收場。
countriesEn: The Eighth Russo-Turkish War of 1828–29 was fought between the Russian Empire and the Ottoman Empire, but three additional actors really shaped the situation: the princes of Armenia and Georgia, a Greece struggling for independence, and the diplomatic pressure of Britain and France. Russia was the attacker. Nicholas I, on the throne since 1825, made the external priority explicit: to turn the Black Sea into a Russian lake, to take the Ottoman gateways in the Caucasus, and to settle the exclusion of Russian traders from the Bosporus. The Russo-Persian war ended with the Treaty of Turkmenchay in 1827, leaving Armenia and Erivan to Russia and worsening the Ottoman position on the eastern flank. In the spring of 1828 Field Marshal Diebitsch crossed the Pruth with the main body and advanced down the Danube, while Wittgenstein and Paskevich commanded in the Caucasus; both axes pressed at once. On the Ottoman side the state was run by Sultan Mahmud II, who had destroyed the Janissary corps in 1826 and was now reorganising the army, with the redif and the new regulars still in the process of being raised; the line infantry was equipped in a jumble and trained unevenly, and the officer corps came largely out of the old system. Diplomatically, Britain and France were anxious that Russia should monopolise the Black Sea and inclined to stop St Petersburg from advancing further towards Constantinople, but their actual actions were limited to diplomatic pressure and naval observation, and neither sent troops. The Greek question was the fuse: Russia entered the war under the banner of supporting the Greek revolt, while the Ottomans regarded any concession to the Greeks as an humiliation, so that the conflict could not be closed without loss of face on one side or the other.
people: 俄方的主導者是沙皇尼古拉一世，他自一八二五年即位後把擴張的目標公開化，並在戰事最關鍵的時刻親赴前線；一八二九年夏他率近衛軍與大批增援抵達多瑙河，直接接管最高指揮，迪比奇轉任參謀長長。他的元帥班底裡最出色的兩位是維特根斯坦與帕斯克維奇：前者主持高加索戰線，後者在戰局末段接掌多瑙河與安納托利亞方向，兩人都主張在鄂圖曼援軍到來之前強行突破，不要把戰爭拖成僵持。迪比奇是這場戰爭中俄軍戰術層面的設計師，他在布加勒斯特的得手與對西利斯特拉的圍攻都出自他的部署，但他的遲疑與保守在埃迪爾內一役暴露無遺。鄂圖曼方面最重要的政治人物是蘇丹馬哈茂德二世，他在一八二六年以血腥手段平定禁衛軍，之後把國家押在一支新式常備軍的重建上，這場戰爭的失敗迫使他把改革推得更急。鄂圖曼軍的戰場指揮由大維齊爾一職主持，埃迪爾內一役的統帥通常記作穆斯塔法帕夏；此外還有在卡爾斯堅守到最後的守將，以及被派往增援、卻未能及時趕到戰場的遠征軍指揮官。英國的威靈頓公爵在歐洲協調對俄的立場，扮演的是幕後角色，但正是他的態度決定了列強對這場戰爭干預的深淺；俄方的另一個關鍵人物是受俄國支持的高加索地方諸侯，他們的配合為高加索戰線提供了嚮導與糧草。
peopleEn: The driving figure on the Russian side was Emperor Nicholas I, who from 1825 made the direction of expansion explicit and came personally to the front at the decisive moment of the campaign. In the summer of 1829 he arrived on the Danube with the Guards and a large reinforcement, took supreme command in person and moved Diebitsch to the post of chief of staff. The two most capable of his marshals were Wittgenstein and Paskevich: the first ran the Caucasian theatre, the second took over the Danube and Anatolian direction in the closing phase, and both argued for breaking through before Ottoman reinforcements could arrive rather than letting the war settle into a stalemate. Diebitsch was the tactical architect of the Russian operations: the capture of Bucharest and the siege of Silistra were his arrangements, but his hesitation and caution were laid bare by the battle of Adrianople. The most important political figure on the Ottoman side was Sultan Mahmud II, who had settled the Janissary revolt in 1826 with terrible bloodshed and then staked the state on building a new regular army; the defeat in this war forced him to push that reform harder. Ottoman command in the field belonged to the office of the Grand Vizier, and the commander of the army at Adrianople is usually recorded as Mustafa Pasha; there were also the garrison that held Kars to the last, and the commanders of relief columns that never reached the battlefield in time. The Duke of Wellington coordinated Europe's position against Russia from behind the scenes, and his attitude determined how far the powers would go in intervening. On the Russian side the other key figures were the Caucasian princes whom Russia supported, who supplied guides and provisions to the Caucasian theatre.
kits: 長槍在這場戰爭裡有一個特別的位置：它在歐洲早已退場，卻在東方與北方還活著。一方面，鄂圖曼帝國的線狀步兵與新募的紅軍仍以長矛為主要的近戰兵器，這是把歐洲長槍的功能原封不動搬過來的制度：槍手在前列射擊，長矛手在後面頂住衝鋒，槍矛之間的比例是鄂圖軍制中最核心的一項配置；而一八二六年被解散的禁衛軍——那支以蛇形旗幟與長矛聞名於世的隊伍——正是歐洲最後一個把長槍當作團隊象徵的軍團，它的解體意味著長槍作為制度的最後一塊化石在這個時代被拆掉。另一方面，俄羅斯的哥薩克與龍騎兵以長矛配卡賓槍作戰，長矛讓騎兵不必開火即可衝鋒，與前線步兵的刺刀構成分隊進攻的標準打法。作戰裝備方面，俄軍以一八〇七年型燧發滑膛步槍與刺刀為主，近衛步兵與龍騎兵另用精度較佳的獵槍式步槍，哥薩克用卡賓槍、彎刀與套索鞭，炮兵是六磅與十二磅野戰炮、獨角獸炮與攻城炮，攻城配備浮橋與壕溝器材；鄂圖曼軍的步槍與手槍多為十八世紀末的燧發式，品質參差，炮兵有十二磅、十八磅野戰炮與臼炮，攻城器械與前線補給靠牛車與篷車輸送，冬季渡河時車隊成了最大的弱點。真正決定成敗的裝備是河運與攻城器材：多瑙河的水位、浮橋與渡口的季節，決定了俄軍能不能把圍城火炮運上岸，也決定了鄂圖曼的援軍能不能及時趕到埃迪爾內。
kitsEn: The pike occupies an unusual place in this war: it had long since left Europe, yet it was still alive in the east and the north. On the one side, the Ottoman line infantry and the newly raised redif still carried the long spear as their principal close-combat weapon, and this was the European pike function transplanted unchanged: the musketeers in the front rank fired, the spear-ranks behind them absorbed the charge, and the proportion of spear to shot was the core configuration of the Ottoman order of battle. The Janissary corps destroyed in 1826 — the corps famous for its serpent banners and its long spears — was the last formation in Europe to treat the pike as an emblem of the regiment, and its elimination meant that the last fossil of the pike as an institution was broken up in this era. On the other side, the Russian Cossacks and dragoons fought with lance and carbine, the lance allowing the horseman to charge without firing, and paired with the infantry bayonet it formed the standard way an attack was organised. As for equipment, the Russian infantry carried the 1807 pattern flintlock smoothbore musket and the bayonet, the Guards infantry and the dragoons a more accurate rifle pattern, the Cossacks carbines, sabres and nagaika whips; the artillery was six- and twelve-pounder smoothbore guns, unicorns and siege pieces, with pontoons and trench tools for siege work. The Ottoman muskets and pistols were mostly late eighteenth-century flintlocks of uneven quality; the artillery had twelve- and eighteen-pounder smoothbore guns and mortars; siege equipment and forward supply moved on ox carts and covered wagons, and in winter the wagon train was the greatest weakness. The equipment that truly decided the outcome was river transport and siege matériel: the level of the Danube, the pontoons and the season of the crossings determined whether the Russians could bring the siege guns ashore, and whether Ottoman relief could reach Adrianople in time.
tactics: 俄軍的戰術是典型的俄式戰役法：邊境上的小規模騷擾不求戰果，目的是把鄂圖曼守軍釘在城裡，等主力集結完畢再一舉渡河作戰。主攻以普魯特河為界線，渡河之後先取布加勒斯特，再以圍城削弱西利斯特拉，同時讓高加索方向連續取勝，把鄂圖曼的注意力拉成兩條線，迫使對方在兩個戰區之間分兵。鄂圖曼方面的錯誤在於把戰爭當成可以靠加倫與援軍解決的短期危機：守軍在西利斯特拉堅持了很長時間，卻沒有在埃迪爾內之前集中兵力反擊俄軍，結果主力在會戰中被各個擊破，此後再也無法重建。埃迪爾內一役中，俄軍先用炮兵齊射壓制正面，再以步兵縱隊與騎兵反擊分割對手的縱隊，鄂圖曼軍在縱深不足的平地上被逐次吃掉。攻城方面，卡爾斯要塞被圍城約一年，俄軍最終不是靠一次強攻，而是靠切斷糧道、消耗守軍，再在援軍被擊潰之後迫使守軍投降；圍城補給靠的是從埃里溫與卡爾斯之間的陸路車隊，這條路正是其後被清剿的目標。騎兵的作用仍然巨大：俄軍的龍騎兵與哥薩克負責掩護側翼、追擊潰退的敵軍，鄂圖曼騎兵在潰退中把損失放大；而哥薩克的長矛與長矛隊形，使俄軍的追擊不必在近距離停下來對射。
tacticsEn: Russian method in this war was the classical Russian way of waging a campaign: small incursions on the frontier were not made to win anything, but to pin the Ottoman garrisons in their towns while the main body concentrated and then crossed in force. The main attack was launched across the Pruth; once over, Bucharest was taken first, then the siege of Silistra wore the garrison down, while continuous success in the Caucasus pulled Ottoman attention onto two fronts and forced the enemy to divide. The Ottoman mistake was to treat the war as a short crisis that could be solved by famine and by reinforcements: the garrison held at Silistra for a long time, but no concentrated counterstroke was made against the Russians before Adrianople, the main army was defeated in detail, and it could never be rebuilt. At Adrianople the Russians opened with massed artillery fire against the front, then used infantry columns and mounted counterattacks to cut the Ottoman columns into separate segments, and the Ottoman army was consumed piece by piece on a plain that offered no depth. In siege operations the fortress of Kars stood invested for the better part of a year, and the Russians did not take it by a single assault: they cut its supply, wore the garrison down, and only forced a surrender after the relief force had been destroyed; the besiegers' provisions came by the land road between Erivan and Kars, and that road was consequently the target of the operations that followed. Cavalry remained decisive: the Russian dragoons and Cossacks covered the flanks and pursued the fleeing army, and the Ottoman cavalry multiplied the losses in the retreat, while the Cossack lance and the lance formations allowed the Russian pursuit to close without stopping to exchange fire at close range.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。戰爭自一八二八年六月俄軍渡過普魯特河開始，至一八二九年九月簽訂《阿德里安堡條約》收場，主要戰役集中在多瑙河與高加索兩個方向。多瑙河方面，渡過普魯特河的俄軍在數萬之譜，迪比奇的主力在布加勒斯特與西利斯特拉之間作戰；埃迪爾內會戰在一八二九年六月二十日前後，沙皇尼古拉一世抵達後俄軍獲得增援，鄂圖曼野戰部隊損失慘重，被俘者以數千計。高加索方面，阿哈爾察利與卡爾斯相繼陷落，卡爾斯的圍城自一八二八年夏延續到一八二九年夏末，前後約一年，守軍在糧盡援絕下投降，埃里溫要塞也在同一時期被俄軍攻取。條約結果是：俄羅斯取得卡爾斯、阿哈爾察利與埃里溫（埃里溫於一八七八年歸還鄂圖曼），普魯特河成為兩國邊界的一部分，鄂圖曼確認此前各條約的效力；同年七月十六日另訂的商約給予俄羅斯在黑海沿岸的通商權利，博斯普魯斯海峽對俄羅斯商船開放。此外，蘇丹於一八二九年四月廢除鄂圖曼的乳製品貿易壟斷與對外關稅壟斷，開放對英通商，與英國簽訂了對英貿易條約。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The war opened with the Russian crossing of the Pruth in June 1828 and closed with the Treaty of Adrianople in September 1829, the main operations being fought on two axes, the Danube and the Caucasus. On the Danube the troops that crossed the Pruth numbered in the tens of thousands, with Diebitsch's main body operating between Bucharest and Silistra; the battle of Adrianople was fought around 20 June 1829, and after the emperor's arrival the Russians received reinforcements while the Ottoman field army suffered heavily, with prisoners numbering in the thousands. In the Caucasus, Akhalkalaki and Kars fell in turn; the siege of Kars ran from the summer of 1828 to the late summer of 1829, about a year in all, and the garrison surrendered starved and cut off, while Erivan was carried by the Russians in the same period. The terms were these: Russia received Kars, Akhalkalaki and Erivan — Erivan was returned to the Ottomans in 1878 — the Pruth became part of the frontier between the two states, and the Porte confirmed the force of the earlier treaties; a separate commercial convention of 16 July 1829 gave Russia trading rights on the Black Sea coast and opened the Bosporus to Russian merchant shipping. In addition, in April 1829 the sultan abolished the Ottoman monopolies on the dairy trade and on foreign customs and opened the country to British commerce, signing a commercial treaty with Britain.
cause: 打起來的原因分近因與遠因。近因是《阿克曼公約》沒有落實：一八二六年由英法擔保、俄羅斯與鄂圖曼簽訂的協議要求鄂圖曼允許俄羅斯商船自由通航、允許俄軍以護送名義進入黑海，鄂圖曼事後並未照辦，海峽對俄船關閉的狀態一直延續到一八二八年，俄羅斯把這視為對自己的公開輕慢。加上高加索前線的變化：俄伊戰爭的結果把埃里溫與納希切萬從波斯手中交到俄羅斯，鄂圖曼既失去了亞美尼亞的門戶，又面對一個直接抵達邊界的鄰國，衝突在所難免。遠因是黑海本身：自克里米亞戰爭之後，這片水域就是俄羅斯與鄂圖曼爭奪的核心，彼得大帝與鄂圖曼先人的遺產、俄國南部的穀物出口與通往地中海的通道、以及黑海煤炭與糧食航線，都集中在這條水道上；鄂圖曼則要防止一個北方強國在它的海峽兩岸取得立足點。戰略層面還有兩項：鄂圖曼在希臘戰場上泥潭深陷，兵員與彈藥被希臘起義拖住，無法在多瑙河投入主力；而希臘的獨立被整個歐洲視為一個問題，英法的介入意圖使雙方都難以在背後交易中體面收場，鄂圖曼寧可打仗也不肯承認一位受外國保護的新君主，於是本可有限解決的通商爭端被推成了一場改變地緣的戰爭。
causeEn: The causes divide into proximate and remote. The proximate cause was the non-implementation of the Convention of Akkerman: the agreement of 1826, guaranteed by Britain and France, required the Porte to let Russian merchant ships pass freely and to allow Russian warships to enter the Black Sea in an escort role. The Ottomans did not carry this out, and the exclusion of Russian shipping from the straits continued into 1828, which Russia took as a public slight. Added to this was the change on the Caucasian front: the Russo-Persian war had handed Erivan and Nakhichevan over from Persia to Russia, so the Ottomans lost the Armenian gateway and now faced a neighbour whose border ran directly against their own. The remote cause was the Black Sea itself. Since the Crimean War this stretch of water had been the core of the contest between Russia and the Porte: the legacy of Peter the Great and the Ottoman sultans, the grain exports of southern Russia and the passage to the Mediterranean, and the coal and grain routes of the Black Sea all ran on this waterway. The Ottomans in turn had to prevent a northern power from gaining a foothold on either shore of the straits. Two further factors were strategic. The Ottomans were bogged down in Greece, with troops and ammunition absorbed by the revolt and no force available for the Danube. And the independence of the Greeks had become a European question: the intention of the British and the French to intervene made a dignified settlement difficult for both sides, and the Ottomans preferred to fight rather than accept a new monarch protected by foreign powers, so that a trade quarrel which could have been settled narrowly was pushed into a war that redrew the map.
impact: 影響的深處有幾層。第一層是黑海：俄羅斯以條約取得多瑙河下游與卡爾斯，等於在鄂圖曼的邊境上打開兩個永久缺口，亞美尼亞的門戶被打通，高加索的戰略天平就此向俄方傾斜；通往地中海的問題並未解決——那要等到一八三三年《君士坦丁堡條約》——但方向已經定了。第二層是鄂圖曼的國家：這場敗仗迫使馬哈茂德二世把改革推到底，軍隊從依賴舊式蒂爾基與各省民兵、已經無法召集的混合體，轉向以歐洲式常備軍、軍事學校與新式炮兵為核心的體系；禁衛軍解體留下的空白只能由新軍填補，而新軍需要常年開支，這筆開支最終壓在財政與稅制上，成為一八三〇年代改革危機與一八三九年對埃戰爭的直接前因。第三層是歐洲體系：英法擔心俄羅斯把勢力伸進海峽，最終聯手阻止了俄軍進一步逼近君士坦丁堡；俄國以放棄在希臘問題上單獨行動換取條約承認，作為交換的是《阿德里安堡條約》本身。戰爭也把希臘問題推到歐洲議程的前列，一八三〇年的倫敦議定書與一八三二年的君士坦丁堡條約都是這場戰爭的直接後果，而俄羅斯在東方問題上的關切從此長期維持。第四層是長矛制度的終結：這是歐洲最後一次以常備軍的規模大量使用長矛作戰，戰後鄂圖曼的新式步兵完全以火槍與刺刀為核心，長矛在鄂圖曼軍中退到儀式與儀仗的位置；而在北方，哥薩克的長矛在此後數十年裡仍是常備的近戰兵器，與其說是制度，不如說是傳統。
impactEn: The effects run to several depths. The first is the Black Sea. By the treaty Russia obtained the lower Danube and Kars, which opened two permanent gaps in the Ottoman frontier, threw open the Armenian gateway and tipped the strategic balance in the Caucasus towards Russia. The question of the Mediterranean was not settled — that awaited the Treaty of Constantinople in 1833 — but the direction had been fixed. The second is the Ottoman state. The defeat forced Mahmud II to push his reform to the end, and the army moved from a mixture of old-style provincial levies and irregulars that could no longer be summoned, towards a system built on European regulars, military schools and modern artillery. The gap left by the destroyed Janissaries could only be filled by a new army, and a new army cost money every year; that burden eventually fell on the treasury and the tax system and became the direct prelude both to the reform crisis of the 1830s and to the war against Egypt in 1839. The third is the European system. Britain and France, alarmed at Russian penetration towards the straits, at last acted together to hold the Russians back from Constantinople; Russia gave up any separate action on Greece in exchange for recognition of the treaty, and the treaty of Adrianople was itself the price. The war also pushed the Greek question to the front of the European agenda: the London Protocol of 1830 and the Treaty of Constantinople of 1832 are direct consequences of it, and Russia's interest in the eastern question became a permanent feature of European politics. The fourth is the end of the pike as an institution. This was the last time European armies fought a war of that scale in which long spears were used in quantity, and afterwards the reformed Ottoman infantry stood entirely on muskets and bayonets, the spear retreating to parade and ceremonial use; in the north, by contrast, the Cossack lance remained a standing close-combat arm for decades more, less an institution than a habit.
result: 一八二九年六月埃迪爾內會戰之後，鄂圖曼主力崩潰，俄軍乘勝進抵阿德里安堡城郊，蘇丹在絕望中同意開議。一八二九年九月十四日簽訂的《阿德里安堡條約》規定：俄羅斯取得卡爾斯、阿哈爾察利與埃里溫（埃里溫在一八七八年歸還），普魯特河成為新的邊界，鄂圖曼確認此前各條約的效力，並開出黑海沿岸的通商權利；同年七月十六日另訂的商約則為博斯普魯斯海峽的通商大門。戰後的鄂圖曼沒有喘息之機：馬哈茂德二世把軍事改革推到最前線，禁衛軍解體留下的空缺只能用歐洲式的新軍填補，新軍的維持費最終引出一八三〇年代的財政危機。俄軍方面，迪比奇的戰役式功業與尼古拉一世親赴前線的姿態都為俄國在歐洲的外交增加了重量，《阿德里安堡條約》在聖彼得堡被視為一次外交勝利，儘管它同時也把俄國對希臘的即時野心暫時壓了下去。整場戰爭的裝備意義在於：長矛作為制度的最後一場大規模實戰在這裡打完了，火槍、刺刀與火炮的組合從此不再需要另一套近戰兵器替它擋住衝鋒；而在北方，哥薩克的長矛與刺刀搭配，仍把同一套原理保留在騎兵隊伍裡。
resultEn: After the battle of Adrianople in June 1829 the Ottoman main army collapsed, the Russians pressed on to the walls of Adrianople, and in despair the sultan agreed to negotiate. The Treaty of Adrianople of 14 September 1829 gave Russia Kars, Akhalkalaki and Erivan — Erivan to be returned in 1878 — made the Pruth the new frontier, confirmed the force of the earlier treaties, and opened the Black Sea ports to Russian trade; the separate commercial convention of 16 July 1829 opened the Bosporus to Russian shipping. The Ottomans had no breathing space afterwards: Mahmud II drove military reform to the forefront, the gap left by the destroyed Janissaries could only be filled with a European-style new army, and the cost of maintaining it produced the fiscal crisis of the 1830s. On the Russian side Diebitsch's campaigning and the emperor's personal presence at the front added weight to Russian diplomacy in Europe, and in St Petersburg the treaty of Adrianople was counted as a diplomatic success, even though it also put a temporary lid on Russia's immediate ambitions in Greece. The equipment meaning of the whole war is that the last large-scale trial of the pike as an institution was fought here; from that point the combination of musket, bayonet and cannon no longer needed a separate close-combat arm to hold the charge, though in the north the Cossack lance and the bayonet kept the same principle alive inside the mounted arm.
